issues.quote: He taught me to count the beats in my head so I would not need to look at a watch.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no method by which Ruedi tracked time, and it does not say she estimated any reading. Her piano readings are stated as read from the kitchen clock.
issues.misreading: A careful solver could read this as a hint that her timings were counted rather than read, and so less reliable. That would cast doubt on the 10:48 and 11:01 piano readings, which are exact kitchen-clock readings in the fact sheet.

issues.quote: When you press the slide, it sounds the time. Low notes for the hours, a doubled note for each quarter, and high notes for each minute past the quarter.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the repeater, its striking, or anyone hearing it at any moment.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as a hint that the time could be audibly fixed by sound at some point in the evening, which would suggest a timing mechanism or a witness whereabouts that the sheet does not give.
